title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-30
source: Reel master > 1 cassette gen > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a monumental 1973 Kiel show featuring an epic Dark Star and soaring Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The concert is celebrated for its mellow, space‑filled vibe and a marathon 28‑minute Dark Star that drifts into an inspired Stella Blue, with tight playing throughout. The soundboard source delivers crystal‑clear audio that lets every instrument shine, making this one of the best ’70s recordings available.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average ~4.7), strong praise for both musical performance and soundboard clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced soundboard feed with no reported dropouts; reviewers describe the recording as brilliant and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, jam‑heavy second set highlighted by a 28‑minute Dark Star that flows into an inspired Stella Blue; overall flow described as mellow yet space‑filled.
